instruction: Can you download the MIT logo in SVG format using GIMP's native tools, without opening any external web browser?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not have built-in web browsing or internet download capabilities. While GIMP can open files from the local filesystem, it cannot fetch files from URLs or interact with websites directly.
